goal.ko: 잘못 알려진 물건·이름을 정정하고 필요한 범위를 말한다
goal.en: Correct a mix-up over a name or object, and ask for only what you need.
goal.de: Korrigiere falsche Angaben zu Namen oder Gegenständen und grenze ein, was du brauchst.

base_manuscript.inheritance: full dialogue, teaching, P/I/R items, answer criteria, help and feedback retained verbatim; overlay is additive

source_contract.title: 아니에요, 이거예요
source_contract.can_do: 잘못 알려진 물건·이름을 정정하고 필요한 범위를 말한다
source_contract.teach: 아니다의 이·가와 존재문의 이·가를 기능별로 분리; 도·만은 별도 상황에서 비교
source_contract.practice: 잘못 건넨 물건에 정정하고 맞는 물건을 가리키기
source_contract.transfer: 처음 보는 배열과 다른 상대에게 정정 후 다시 확인; A1.1 종합

context.ko: 모자는 눈앞에 있지만 소유자 표가 내 카드와 달라요. 도깨비가 내 것이라고 잘못 건넸어요.
context.en: The 모자 is visible, but its owner tag differs from yours. The gatekeeper handed it to you as if it were yours.
context.de: Der Gegenstand 모자 ist sichtbar, aber sein Besitzschild passt nicht zu deiner Karte. Der Torwächter hat ihn dir irrtümlich als deinen gegeben.

prompt.ko: 물건이 없다고 하지 않고 내 것이 아님을 정정해요.
prompt.en: Correct the ownership without claiming the object is absent.
prompt.de: Korrigiere den Besitz, ohne zu sagen, dass der Gegenstand fehlt.

required_words_and_senses.sense_ko: 명사로 제시한 정체·소유를 부정하는 배운 형태

items.required_control: ORAL-START: choose explanation language; demonstrate play, reply and optional help before task
items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.ko: 보이는 물건의 소유자가 다르다는 점을 말해요.
level1.en: Say that the visible object belongs to someone else.
level1.de: Sage, dass der sichtbare Gegenstand jemand anderem gehört.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 없어요는 유무의 말이에요. 여기에는 물건이 있으니 누구 것인지 정정해요.
wrong_feedback.en: 없어요 reports absence. The object is present, so correct whose it is.
wrong_feedback.de: 없어요 meldet ein Fehlen. Der Gegenstand ist vorhanden; korrigiere daher den Besitz.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Correct the ownership of the currently handed 모자. Accept its correct noun with appropriate negation, 제 것이 아니에요, or an equally clear referential alternative. Do not substitute the other object noun. Topic particles may be appropriate; exact particle string is not sole correctness. Absence statement conflicts with this present-visible scope.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

context.ko: 새 역할 이름은 하린. 상대가 다른 이름으로 불렀어요. 예전 소개 카드 설정과 별개예요.
context.en: Your new role name is 하린. The partner used a different name. This is separate from earlier introduction cards.
context.de: Dein neuer Rollenname ist 하린. Die andere Person hat einen anderen Namen verwendet. Das gehört nicht zu früheren Vorstellungskarten.

prompt.en: Reply no and give the correct name.
prompt.de: Antworte verneinend und nenne den richtigen Namen.

required_words_and_senses.sense_ko: 임시 역할 이름, 받침으로 끝나는 감수용 한글 표기
배운 명사 정체 서술형; 받침별 이름 시범

required_grammar_functions: negative response 아니요 plus learned identity
items.required_control: ORAL-START: choose explanation language; demonstrate play, reply and optional help before task
items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.ko: 틀린 이름을 거절한 다음 카드 이름을 말해요.
level1.en: Reject the wrong name, then give the card’s name.
level1.de: Verneine den falschen Namen und nenne den Namen auf der Karte.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 상대가 잘못 안 이름 하나만 고치면 돼요. 새 개인정보는 필요 없어요.
wrong_feedback.en: You only need to correct the one mistaken name. No new personal information is needed.
wrong_feedback.de: Du musst nur den falsch verstandenen Namen korrigieren. Weitere persönliche Angaben sind nicht nötig.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Accept 아니요 + correct identity, or full wrongname이/가 아니에요 + correct name. Short 아니요 is response negation, not evidence of noun-negation morphology; assess identity correction separately.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

context.ko: 앞 대화: 수진은 모자가 있어요. 내 역할 카드에도 모자가 있어요. 둘 다 있다는 사실을 전해요.
context.en: Previous turn: Sujin has a hat. Your role card also shows a hat. Communicate that both have one.
context.de: Vorherige Aussage: Sujin hat einen Hut. Deine Rollenkarte zeigt ebenfalls einen Hut. Teile mit, dass beide einen haben.

prompt.en: Use 도 to add that the same is true of you.
prompt.de: Ergänze mit 도, dass dasselbe für dich gilt.

required_words_and_senses.sense_ko: 앞 사람과 동일한 사실에 나를 추가
모자를 가지고 있거나 지정 범위에 모자가 있는 상태; 해당 문맥에서 판단

items.required_control: ORAL-START: choose explanation language; demonstrate play, reply and optional help before task
items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.ko: 앞 사람과 나에게 같은 사실이 있어요.
level1.en: The same fact applies to the previous person and you.
level1.de: Dieselbe Angabe gilt für die zuvor genannte Person und für dich.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 저는 모자가 있어요도 내 정보는 전해요. 같은 사실에 더한다는 뜻의 도를 썼는지는 따로 확인해요.
wrong_feedback.en: 저는 모자가 있어요 communicates your fact. We check separately whether 도 adds the same fact.
wrong_feedback.de: 저는 모자가 있어요 teilt deine Angabe mit. Getrennt wird geprüft, ob 도 dieselbe Angabe ergänzt.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Accept 저도 모자가 있어요 or equivalent explicit additive meaning. 저는... communicates possession but additive target unobserved, not factual error.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

context.ko: 제안된 물건은 물과 우산. 내 역할 카드는 물만 필요하고 다른 물건은 필요 없다고 정해요.
context.en: The offered objects are water and an umbrella. Your role card needs only 물, not the other object.
context.de: Angeboten werden Wasser und Regenschirm. Deine Rollenkarte braucht nur 물, den anderen Gegenstand nicht.

prompt.en: Ask for only the needed object.
prompt.de: Bitte nur um den benötigten Gegenstand.

items.relationship: known house companions; gatekeeper roleplay; polite Korean to elder characters

level1.ko: 두 선택지 중 하나로 범위를 좁혀요.
level1.en: Restrict your request to one of the two options.
level1.de: Beschränke deine Bitte auf eine der zwei Möglichkeiten.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.
level2.de: Hör dir ein Beispiel für diese Situation an und probiere es mit Hilfe.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 물건 이름과 주세요만으로도 부탁은 가능해요. 다른 것은 제외한다는 뜻까지 전달했는지 따로 확인해요.
wrong_feedback.en: An object name with 주세요 can make a request. Check separately whether it also excludes the other item.
wrong_feedback.de: Gegenstand und 주세요 können eine Bitte ausdrücken. Prüfe getrennt, ob damit auch der andere Gegenstand ausgeschlossen wird.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Accept noun만 주세요 / noun만 필요해요 / explicit only-equivalent. noun 주세요 may request correctly but restriction unobserved. Do not make a natural request an unrelated wrong answer.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.

context.ko: 가까운 칸의 내 소유자 표 모자와 먼 칸의 수진 모자. 상대가 먼 모자를 가리켰어요. R에서는 칸 위치와 모자 색을 바꿔요.
context.en: Your hat is in a near compartment; Sujin’s is farther away. The partner points to the farther hat. R changes compartment positions and hat colours.
context.de: Dein Hut liegt im nahen Fach, Sujins Hut weiter weg. Die andere Person zeigt auf den fernen Hut. R ändert die Fachpositionen und Hutfarben.

prompt.ko: 맞는 물건을 가리키고 이거예요로 확인해요. 필요하면 먼저 주인을 정정해요.
prompt.en: Point to the correct object and confirm it with 이거예요. Correct the ownership first if needed.
prompt.de: Zeige auf den richtigen Gegenstand und bestätige ihn mit 이거예요. Korrigiere bei Bedarf zuerst den Besitz.

level1.ko: 화자 가까운 내 소유자 표를 확인해요.
level1.en: Check your owner tag near the speaker.
level1.de: Prüfe dein Besitzschild nahe bei der sprechenden Person.

level2.ko: 같은 상황의 시범을 듣고 함께 해요.
level2.en: Listen to a model for this situation and try with support.

help_policy.effect: same-audio replay logged; translation/form/model/first-syllable support changes target independence; retry remains same item

wrong_feedback.ko: 색만 외우지 않고 이번 소유자 표와 거리를 확인해요.
wrong_feedback.en: Check this owner tag and distance rather than memorising a colour.
wrong_feedback.de: Prüfe das aktuelle Besitzschild und die Entfernung, statt eine Farbe auswendig zu verwenden.

accepted_response_policy.rule: Goal: correct referent and this-identification. 이거예요 alone does not demonstrate negation; no invented negation credit. Pointing only is action evidence, not spoken production.
accepted_response_policy.target_observation: Observe only the listed grammar function; an alternative grammatical form can achieve communication without demonstrating this target.
